Update: Additional troubleshooting performed.

VRChat Settings checked:

- All Safety settings enabled (all friends)

- "Show Avatar" tested on individual players

- Avatar Performance Rank set to Very Poor

- All graphics settings set to maximum

- Allow Untrusted URLs: enabled

- Avatar Interactions: enabled

Launch options tried:

- -force-d3d11 → launches but no improvement

- -force-glcore → InitializeEngineGraphics failed

- -force-vulkan → InitializeEngineGraphics failed

- --disable-amd-stutter-workaround → no improvement

AMD Radeon Software settings checked:

- Anti-Lag: disabled

- Radeon Boost: disabled

- Image Sharpening: disabled

- Tessellation: AMD Optimized

- Color Enhancement: disabled

Driver versions tested:

- 26.10.21.05 (original) → no improvement

- 26.3.1 (downgrade) → no improvement

- 25.12.1 (downgrade attempt) → incompatible with RX 9060 XT,

  installation failed

Additional notes:

- Other players using the same avatars can see the emission effects

- Issue occurs regardless of world or avatar

- PICO 4 used as VR HMD via PC streaming

I have been experiencing this issue since I started playing VRChat 

in June 2026, and it has never improved. This greatly diminishes 

my experience in VRChat. 😢

details:
GPU: AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT

OS: Windows 11

Issue: Glow/emission effects on other players' avatars are 

completely invisible to me, but visible to other players.

- All Safety settings are enabled

- Avatar Performance Rank set to Very Poor

- Tried launch options: -force-d3d11, --disable-amd-stutter-workaround

- All AMD Radeon Software settings checked

- Issue exists since first use
title: RX 9060 XT: Emission/Glow effects on avatars not visible
